The endpoint used DNS tunneling via high-entropy TXT queries to the domain ns1.exfil-c2.example.com, resolving to IP 203.0.113.77. Analysis revealed prior Cobalt Strike C2 activity linked to another compromised host (WS-FIN-042) within the same department. The external IP 203.0.113.77 has been observed scanning internal assets and is confirmed as part of known malicious infrastructure. Immediate containment actions included blocking the C2 IP at the firewall and executing a remediation playbook on the affected endpoint. No malware was detected during a full EPP scan, suggesting fileless or living-off-the-land techniques were used. Lateral movement and privilege escalation attempts were identified in logs from the initial compromise on WS-FIN-042.

timeline.description: External IP 203.0.113.77 conducts Nmap SYN scan against internal host 10.0.2.15 (WS-IT-101). Logged by IDS.
Host WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42) initiates outbound HTTPS connection to 198.51.100.23, later identified as Cobalt Strike C2.
Suspicious rundll32 execution detected from Temp directory on WS-FIN-042.
IDS alerts on Cobalt Strike Beacon C2 activity from WS-FIN-042 to 198.51.100.23.
Failed Kerberos TGT request from WS-FIN-042, indicating potential privilege escalation attempt.
Lateral movement via SMB to file server 10.0.5.50 from WS-FIN-042.
Data exfiltration alert triggered: WS-FIN-019 (10.0.4.19) initiates 2.3 GB DNS tunneling session to ns1.exfil-c2.example.com (203.0.113.77).
Firewall rule deployed to block outbound traffic to 203.0.113.77.
Remediation playbook 'remediate_dns_tunneling.yml' executed on WS-FIN-019. Full EPP scan returns no threats.

title: Suspicious DNS Tunneling via High-Entropy TXT Queries
id: 8a9d8b1c-1f2e-4d3a-9c4b-5e6f7a8b9c0d
description: Detects DNS queries with high entropy subdomains, often used in DNS tunneling exfiltration.
status: experimental
author: SOC Team
references:
    - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1071/004/
logsource:
    category: dns_query
    product: network
detection:
    selection:
        query_type: TXT
        subdomain_length: > 30
        entropy: > 3.5
    condition: selection
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate high-entropy domains (e.g., CDNs, dynamic DNS)
level: high
